item.title: Bulletin updated at 21:10 HKT 29/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it will be generally fine over southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong in the latter part of this week. It will be windy over the region. An upper-air disturbance will bring a few showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kong-rey will continue to intensify and move in the general direction of the southern part of Taiwan in the next couple of days. It will then have a higher chance to move northwards and edge closer to northern Fujian, but also have a chance to edge closer to the vicinity of the Fujian-Guangdong boundary.
